about_subtitle: Your Intelligent Companion for Aloe Vera Plant Health & Care
about_mission_desc: AloeMithra is an intelligent plant healthcare system designed specifically for Aloe Vera (Aloe barbadensis Miller). It helps farmers, herbal growers, and home plant lovers quickly identify foliar diseases, understand visual heatmaps, and adopt safe, research-backed organic and cultural care.
about_steps_title: How to Use AloeMithra in 3 Simple Steps
about_step1_desc: Photograph a single affected leaf against a plain, clean dark surface with good natural lighting.
about_step2_desc: Our vision model pinpoints the condition and generates a visual heatmap showing exact infected regions.
about_step3_desc: Receive safe, tailored organic sanitation, soil, and management steps designed specifically for that diagnosis.
about_tip1_desc: Aloe vera is a succulent. Water deeply only when the top 2 inches of soil are completely dry. Never let pots sit in standing water.
about_tip2_desc: Provide bright, indirect sunlight (6 hours daily). Harsh midday scorching sun causes sunburn (browning).
about_tip3_desc: Use sandy cactus/succulent potting mix with perlite or coarse sand to prevent root rot.
about_dev_toggle_hint: Click to view neural network architecture, model validation metrics, dataset specifications, and research constraints.
about_dev_arch: Model Architecture: EfficientNetB0 (Transfer Learning) with custom dense classification head.
about_dev_accuracy: Validation Performance: Reached approximately 83% validation accuracy across controlled test evaluations.
about_dev_dataset: Training Dataset: Trained on photographic samples of individual leaves against plain dark non-reflective surfaces.
about_dev_constraints: Environmental Constraints: The model has not been validated on complex open-field weed backgrounds or extreme direct glare.
about_dev_api: Decoupled API: RESTful architecture with Flask endpoints (/api/analyze, /api/knowledge, /api/chat).
